correctness.rationale: The transition matrix invariant classes E (two selected endpoints), R (remaining a-2 first-part vertices) and B (opposite part) give a three-by-three equitable quotient, antisymmetric mode eigenvalue -w/(b+w), and n-4 zero eigenvalues. The spectral sum yields K_{a,b}(w)-K_{a,b}(0)=w[4(a-2)w-3b]/(2(b+2w)(ab+w)), so sign reverses at w=3b/[4(a-2)]. With x=w/b, independent symbolic differentiation gives the stated polynomial (8a^2-12a-2)x^2+8a(a-2)x-3a, which has one positive root for integer a>=3; the derivative is negative before and positive after. The proof handles b=1 and nonlazy bipartite periodicity. This matches an earlier all-parameter exact derivation; finite matrix checks in the package are supporting, not an all-integer proof.
